remarks: This totally updated condo in Stamford's Springdale neighborhood offers comfort, convenience, and easy living. Totally Renovate with new floors, bath appliances and paint. with an open living and dining area that is perfect for entertaining. The spacious bedroom has great closets, a new full bath. Enjoy the convenience of laundry on the same floor the next door down, elevator access, a fitness room, and one reserved parking spaces. The HOA includes heat, hot water, and cooking gas. Just minutes to the Metro North Springdale station, as well as neighborhood restaurants and shops, this home delivers exceptional value in a prime location
